snippet.title: C64 Longplay: William Wobbler
snippet.description:
Another first-time walkthrough video, this one a bizarre and comical puzzle/exploration game from Antony Crowther. Much thanks to Lasse Öörni (Cadaver) for supplying tips on Lemon64.

The locations are random at the start of each game but I save-stated it at that point so that I could draw a map. God knows how this was expected to be completed back in the day, unless you used an Action Replay cartridge, perhaps.

The only thing that I and many others couldn't solve is the PETSCII puzzle you are given to solve after collecting all 10 Clues at the end. It remains a mystery...

REVIEW: https://archive.org/details/Computer_Gamer_Issue_07_1985-10_Argus_Press_GB/page/n59/mode/2up
ADVERT: https://archive.org/details/Computer_Gamer_Issue_07_1985-10_Argus_Press_GB/page/n99/mode/2up
